<a name="comboboxOptions"></a>

## comboboxOptions
Returns the configured combobox options, automatically appending an
 "Other" entry when allowOther is true and it is not already present.

**Kind**: global variable  
<a name="finalComboboxValue"></a>

## finalComboboxValue
Returns the free-text "Other" input when that option is selected,
 otherwise returns the selected combobox value.

**Kind**: global variable
